units.pressure: Pa absolute except explicitly named pressure-update delta Pa

scope.selection: Four closed saved guard/terminal/native metadata records named in this bundle; no live cases were changed.
scope.shared_interpretation: All are checkpoint restarts from earlier t=0 cold campaigns, not fresh t=0 runs. All ended with normal solver End and complete 14-field native checkpoints, but each failed its numerical diagnostic stop gate. No physical cavitation or discharge validation claim is made.
scope.phase_ledger: Cumulative water/gas ledger defects are retained in kilograms and qualified as diagnostics, not tolerances.
scope.pressure_floor: Raw pressure-floor contact counts and selected guardian event records are retained. Guardian fields named clipped_liquid_mass_kg/clipped_liquid_volume_m3 mean liquid support in cells where pressure was floored, not water removed from the solution. A run-wide minimum over every raw contact is null unless the guardian saved that reduction; terminal-step raw minimum and selected event values are separate.

schema_contract.format: Strict UTF-8 JSON; non-finite numbers are forbidden.
schema_contract.null_policy: Unknown or unretained values are null with a paired reason; they are never replaced with zero. Raw guardian event fields retain their original names and have explicit semantics.

start.clarification: Warm continuation from the stopped corrected-flush stock stage; not a new t=0 start.

case.join_mode_source_or_qualification: The experiment identifies the corrected feed-to-flush junction; the mesh-preparation wall comparison names the new 299214-cell mesh as flush-at-inlet.
case.initial_state_description: Original campaign t=0 state was documented as a genuine cold start. This stage itself starts from the complete native checkpoint identified in start; it is a checkpoint restart, not a fresh cold start.

endpoint.guard_write_now_reason: raw pressure update contacted the configured 10 kPa floor

pressure_floor_diagnostic.runwide_minimum_raw_contact_pressure_una: The saved guardian records contact count and selected first/maximum-clipping events, not a min reduction over every raw-contact pass. Do not treat an event minimum as run-wide.
pressure_floor_diagnostic.liquid_support_semantics: Liquid support mass/volume in cells whose raw pressure was at or below the configured floor. This is not water removed, clipped from alpha, or a phase-ledger loss.

first_raw_contact_semantics.interpretation: Liquid support mass/volume in cells whose raw pressure was at or below the configured floor. This is not water removed, clipped from alpha, or a phase-ledger loss.

maximum_clipped_liquid_event_semantics.interpretation: Liquid support mass/volume in cells whose raw pressure was at or below the configured floor. This is not water removed, clipped from alpha, or a phase-ledger loss.

outer_iteration_updates.interpretation: Guard-observed outer-to-outer changes; a stop diagnostic, not a complete nonlinear residual or validation metric.

phase_mass_ledger.qualification: Cumulative phase-ledger diagnostics carried from the campaign t=0 seed; not acceptance tolerances or proof of local conservation.

initial_inventory_difference_vs_correcte.qualification: Reference inventory for cross-run initial-mass context.

interpretation.qualification: Exploratory numerical outcomes only. A negative raw pressure before floor clipping is a solver-floor diagnostic, not evidence of physical cavitation.
